'''Operations branch''' was a section of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]'s [[Special Threats Division]]. Following her actions during the [[Corellian Crisis]], [[Belindi Kalenda]] was promoted to the rank of [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] and assigned to head up the Operations branch.<ref name="CTD" />
